title: Model: declaration, parameter, type-use, and default annotations
objective: Extract visible and invisible annotations, nested values, defaults, targets, and retention evidence from class files.
acceptance_criteria: Class, member, parameter, record-component, and type-use locations remain distinguishable.
Primitive, enum, class, annotation, and array element values are lossless.
Meta-annotation traversal is bounded and explicit about missing annotation types.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
